SR-26

STEERING — Steering Column (CANADA)

14. REMOVE TILT STEERING ADJUSTING NUT AND PIN

D6398

15. REMOVE TILT STEERING SUPPORT STOPPER BOLT
Remove the nut, support stopper bolt and cover.

D6399

16. REMOVE SERRATION BOLTS
Temporarily install the two nuts to the two serration bolts
end for protection, and tap out the two serration bolts from
the upper bracket.

D6400

17. REMOVE COLUMN UPPER BRACKET
(a) Remove the column upper bracket from the breaka-
way bracket.

D6401

(b) Remove the two bolts.

D6402
